title: Namma Basava
desc: A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.

title: Arya
desc: Bizarre events compel a gentleman to pursue his authentic identity. Consequently, these unusual anomalies precipitate this earnest quest.

title: Amrithadhare
desc: Puru and Amritha are a married couple deeply in love with each other. However, they face challenges as they try to balance their conflicting desires in their marriage.

title: Sarkari Haraju
desc: A man gets into a conflict with a powerful politician after he tries to retrieve a large sum of money that he has given to his fraudulent lover, who happens to be the latter's daughter.

title: Neelakanta
desc: A man is obedient towards his mother and overcomes all the obstacles life throws his way. Unfortunately, his mother disapproves of his marriage and causes problems for him.
